findings.title: Multiple users from one source
findings.description: 4 different users failed to log on from source 203.0.113.45 within a 60 s window: alice.test, bob.test, carol.test, ghost.test
reasons: 8 failed logons with different user names from one source
Some attempts used user names that do not exist (sub-status 0xC0000064), which suggests guessing

findings.title: Failed logon (event 4625)
findings.description: Failed logon for user alice.test from source 203.0.113.45 (logon type 3, status 0xc000006d, sub-status 0xc000006a)
reasons: A single failed logon is common (a mistyped password); it matters only as part of a pattern
